subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fuel
solution:
The Correct answer is **'Deter.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fuel**: Fuel is a substance that provides energy when burned. It can be used to power machines, vehicles, or provide heat. (जलाना)

 
 
• **Example:** Gasoline is a common **fuel **used in cars.
 
 
 
• **Deter**: Deter means to discourage or prevent someone from doing something. (रोकना)
 
 
• **Example:** The harsh punishment is meant to **deter **crime.
 
 
 
• Hence, The correct antonym is 'deter.'

Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) **Encourag**e (प्रोत्साहित करना): Encourage means to give someone confidence or hope to do something. 
 
• Option 2) **Project **(परियोजना): Project refers to a planned undertaking or activity. 
 
• Option 4) **Associate** (जुड़ना): Associate means to connect or link something with something else.
